title: Normalize runtime terminology and roadmap store naming
summary: Rename or reclassify non-runtime helper modules so `src/runtime/**` is the sole CodeWiki Runtime owner and roadmap persistence no longer uses runtime naming.

goal.outcome: Runtime naming aligns with the accepted daemon-runtime taxonomy without changing roadmap behavior.
acceptance: `src/runtime/**` remains the only CodeWiki Runtime source root.
Roadmap persistence/mutation helpers use `src/roadmap/store.ts` naming instead of misleading runtime naming where touched by this migration.
Imports, docs, and tests use the new naming consistently.
Typecheck and targeted roadmap/store smoke tests pass.
non_goals: Do not implement daemon dispatch in this task.
Do not change roadmap task semantics.
Do not define daemon job/run schema in this task.
verification: search proves misleading live roadmap runtime helper names are removed or documented as deferred

delta.desired: Runtime terminology is unambiguous before daemon implementation.
delta.current: Roadmap persistence imports now target `src/roadmap/store.ts`; historical cancelled task metadata may still mention the old path.
delta.closure: Close when naming is migrated or explicitly documented with no drift and checks pass.
